questions.text: There are six balls in an over. How many balls are there in three overs?
Which letter comes next: A, C, E, G, ___?
questions.why: Each step skips one letter: A (b) C (d) E (f) G (h) I.

questions.text: What has to be broken before you can use it?
questions.why: You have to break an egg before you can use it.

questions.text: A light is off. You flick its switch seven times. Is it now on or off?
questions.why: Every two flicks cancel out, so after an odd number like seven, the light has changed state: off becomes on.
The gaps go up by 2 each time (3, 5, 7, 9), so the next gap is 11: 27 + 11 = 38.

questions.text: Which of these words does NOT rhyme with the others when spoken: BOUGH, COUGH, PLOUGH, NOW?
questions.why: BOUGH, PLOUGH and NOW all end in an "ow" sound, but COUGH is said "coff".

questions.text: Dolly the sheep was born in July 1996 and died in February 2003. How old was she, in whole years?
questions.why: She turned 6 in July 2002 and died in February 2003, before she could turn 7.

questions.text: At what temperature are Celsius and Fahrenheit the same?
A cube of side 3 is painted red and cut into 27 unit cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two red faces?
questions.why: Only the middle cube on each edge has exactly two painted faces, and a cube has 12 edges.

questions.text: What do you get if you add up every number on a roulette wheel, from 0 to 36?
questions.why: Pair them up: 1 + 36, 2 + 35 and so on make 18 pairs of 37, which is 666 (the 0 adds nothing).

questions.text: The letters of ELEVEN PLUS TWO can be rearranged into another sum with the same answer. What is it?
questions.why: TWELVE PLUS ONE uses exactly the same thirteen letters, and both sums make 13.
